key_insight: The paper introduces a fully discrete, symmetric N-phase Navier–Stokes–Cahn–Hilliard scheme that preserves conservation laws, saturation, and energy dissipation for arbitrary density ratios.
engineering_relevance: This gives practitioners a robust framework for simulating complex incompressible multiphase flows without biasing any phase, even when densities differ greatly.
method: Symmetric fully discrete N-phase NSCH formulation
Exact preservation of phase volume, phase mass, total volume, and total mass
Discrete energy-dissipation law with saturation constraint preservation
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical verification of the structure-preserving properties and robustness on representative multiphase flow problems.
watch_item: The scheme is structure-preserving by design, but implementing it for general N-phase problems may be computationally demanding and requires careful enforcement of the discrete constraints.
paper_title: Symmetric structure-preserving discretization of N-phase incompressible fluid mixtures with arbitrary density ratios
